correctness.rationale: All initial states factor exactly through the 4-symbol column-count map. Exhaustive local verification of 4^5 and 4^6 input windows proves two-step weights cannot be 2 and adjacent two-step weights cannot both be 1; this forces time-three weights into {0,3} and time-four extinction. Complete enumeration for n=3,4 and constructive witnesses for every n>=5 establish sharpness. Two separate source packages were executed; the direct binary checker independently covered all n=3..6 states. No unproven extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: This is a complete, sharp nilpotency classification across the full one-parameter family of three-row Seeds tori, with an all-state constant-time bound. It reveals a genuine geometric confinement boundary for a canonical chaotic planar automaton and proves a structural forbidden-weight mechanism. It does not merely recompute a known oscillator or bound a small fixed instance.
